title: The Roots We Carry
logline: A father in Addis Ababa answers his son abroad, who asked what Ethiopia is, by showing him what his own father once showed him.
audience: Young Ethiopians and the Ethiopian diaspora, watching on their phones (vertical first) and sharing with family.
intent: Feel proud of their heritage and connected to home, and leave knowing that however far they travel, they carry their roots with them.

style.style_block: cinematic film still, warm golden-hour light, soft 35mm film grain, rich earthy palette of ochre, deep green and coffee brown, gentle realistic style, shallow depth of field, subject centred for vertical and horizontal crops

character.name: Abba (the father)
character.description: a fictional Ethiopian man in his fifties, short grey-flecked beard, kind tired eyes, white cotton gabi over a simple collared shirt

voice.name: Charon
voice.style_instruction: Say in Amharic, slowly and warmly, like a loving father speaking to his son far away

music.caption: warm cinematic Ethiopian instrumental in the tizita mode, krar and masinko over soft strings and a low drum, nostalgic and hopeful, gentle texture with no strong lead melody, slow build

cues.description: soft masinko drone enters with the mountains
krar joins as the coffee is roasted; warmer
low drum and strings lift for the modern city
theme returns softly, resolves, fades under the end card

shots.reason: Establishes the homeland and the son's question that the whole film answers.
shots.image_prompt: Ethiopian highlands at dawn, layered green mountains with mist in the valleys, a narrow footpath and a few round thatched tukuls
shots.motion_prompt: slow aerial push forward, mist drifting gently, camera steady
shots.narration: ልጄ ሆይ፣ ኢትዮጵያ ምንድን ናት ብለህ ጠይቀኸኛል።
shots.subtitle_en: My son, you asked me what Ethiopia is.

shots.reason: Introduces the father, the voice of the film, answering from home.
shots.image_prompt: Abba sitting by a wooden window in a modest Addis Ababa home, morning light on his face, holding a phone to record a message, a small coffee cup beside him
shots.motion_prompt: he lifts his eyes from the phone and smiles softly, static camera
shots.narration: ዛሬ አባቴ ያሳየኝን ሁሉ ላሳይህ እፈልጋለሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: Today I want to show you everything my father showed me.

shots.reason: The memory begins: a grandfather passing knowledge to a boy, the chain of generations.
shots.image_prompt: seen from behind, an elderly Ethiopian grandfather in a white gabi with a walking stick and a small boy walking together on a mountain path at sunrise, warm nostalgic tone
shots.motion_prompt: they walk slowly away from camera, gentle wind in the grass, camera follows gently
shots.narration: እነዚህ ተራሮች የአያቶቻችንን ታሪክ በዝምታ ይጠብቃሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: These mountains quietly keep the story of our ancestors.

shots.reason: One landmark stands for the history: a church carved from a single rock.
shots.image_prompt: a cross-shaped church carved down into red volcanic rock, seen from above at golden hour, carved steps and a trench around it, a few pilgrims in white
shots.narration: ከአንድ ዓለት የተፈለፈሉ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት፤ በእምነትና በትዕግሥት የተሠሩ።
shots.subtitle_en: Churches carved from a single rock, built with faith and patience.

shots.reason: Family values: the elders' wisdom of love and forgiveness under the warka tree.
shots.image_prompt: village elders in white gabis seated in a circle under a huge warka (sycamore fig) tree, dappled afternoon light, calm conversation
shots.motion_prompt: leaves sway softly, one elder gestures gently, static camera
shots.narration: በዋርካ ሥር ሽማግሌዎች ፍቅርንና ይቅርታን አስተማሩን።
shots.subtitle_en: Under the warka tree, the elders taught us love and forgiveness.

shots.reason: The coffee ceremony begins; the smell of roasting coffee is the memory of home.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of green coffee beans roasting dark brown in a flat iron pan over charcoal, white smoke rising, fresh grass and frankincense nearby
shots.motion_prompt: smoke curls upward, beans shift slightly, slow push-in
shots.narration: ቡና ሲቆላ፣ መዓዛው ቤቱን በሙሉ ይሰበስባል።
shots.subtitle_en: When the coffee is roasted, its aroma gathers the whole house.

shots.reason: Family together around one table: the heart of what he is passing on.
shots.image_prompt: a black clay jebena pouring coffee into small white sini cups on a tray, family members' hands reaching in, warm lamp light, grass on the floor
shots.motion_prompt: coffee pours in a slow steady stream, steam rises, static camera
shots.narration: አንድ ሲኒ፣ አንድ ማዕድ፣ አንድ ቤተሰብ።
shots.subtitle_en: One cup, one table, one family.

shots.reason: Turns from the past to the present: Ethiopia moving into the modern world.
shots.image_prompt: Addis Ababa skyline at dusk, modern towers and the light rail with lights coming on, warm sky, the hills beyond
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan right across the skyline, city lights flicker on
shots.narration: ዛሬ ደግሞ የአንተ ትውልድ አዲስ ታሪክ እየጻፈ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: And today, your generation is writing a new story.

shots.reason: The dreams of the young generation, his hope for the future.
shots.image_prompt: young Ethiopians working together in a bright Addis Ababa studio, one sketching a design, one at a laptop, traditional woven patterns on the wall
shots.motion_prompt: they look up and share a smile, gentle push-in
shots.subtitle_en: Your dreams and your hard work are my hope.

shots.reason: The son abroad receives the message: the diaspora viewer sees himself.
shots.image_prompt: a young Ethiopian man seen from behind and side, standing at an apartment window in a snowy foreign city at night, holding a small white sini cup, a phone glowing in his hand
shots.motion_prompt: snow falls outside, steam rises from the cup, very slow push-in
shots.narration: የትም ብትሄድ፣ ይህን ሁሉ ይዘህ ትሄዳለህ።
shots.subtitle_en: Wherever you go, you carry all of this with you.

shots.reason: The father's final words land the film's intent: you carry your roots.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of Abba smiling with gentle pride, a thin line of coffee smoke drifting in front of him, warm window light
shots.motion_prompt: he gives a small nod and smiles, smoke drifts across, static camera
shots.narration: እኛን ይዘህ ትሄዳለህ። ሥርህን ይዘህ ትሄዳለህ።
shots.subtitle_en: You carry us. You carry your roots.
